headline: Trump Signs Executive Order Aimed at Lowering Single-Family Housing Costs
summary: Donald Trump signed an executive order specifically aimed at reducing single-family housing costs across the United States.
why: Federal housing directives can influence residential construction regulations, zoning frameworks, and affordability metrics in the U.S. property market.

impacts.name: Residential Housing
impacts.why: Executive initiatives targeting housing expenses seek to alter supply constraints and regulatory burdens for builders.
